title: ID0378368-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R1 170001369] Scramble image
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The charger's HMI doesn't work.
Root cause: Scrambled image
Solution:
A soft reboot via the SCB has resolved the issue.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Active
